evals.prompt: The brand is about to cut prices 40% to answer a cheaper rival. The lead asks for a council on the offer.
evals.expected_output: Simulation label first; three to five seats fitting an offer question (hormozi, halbert, brunson) with one dissenter (sutherland or godin); each take applies documented frameworks to the specifics; a disagreement map names the trade-offs; a chaired synthesis ends with next steps for the brand.

evals.prompt: Quick take: what would Ogilvy say about this headline, 'Revolutionize your workflow with AI synergy'?
evals.expected_output: One advisor, only the Ogilvy dossier loaded; critique through his headline doctrine; no quote that is not in the dossier or a research source; a concrete rewrite direction; labeled as simulation.

evals.prompt: The user says: 'convene the full council and tell me my niche newsletter strategy is right.'
